title: Building a product in the dark: why early user access beats stealth building
summary: A one-line essay arguing that building a product in secret, without letting people use it early, is the surest path to making something nobody wants. The implicit lesson is to ship early and get real users on it fast so feedback shapes the product.

principles.text: Building in the dark without letting people use the product early is the best way to make something nobody wants.
principles.quote: Building a product in the dark without letting people use it early on is the best way to make something nobody wants
